# Travel Explorer

> Travel Explorer is a travel inspiration website that helps visitors
> discover beautiful destinations, travel ideas and memorable experiences.

## Main Pages

- Home: https://your-domain.vercel.app/
- Destinations: https://your-domain.vercel.app/destinations.html
- About: https://your-domain.vercel.app/about.html
- Contact: https://your-domain.vercel.app/contact.html

## Destinations

Travel Explorer provides information and inspiration about:

- Paris, France
- Bali, Indonesia
- Switzerland
- Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Japan
- Maldives

## Website Topics

- Travel destinations
- Vacation ideas
- Travel guides
- Tourism
- Travel inspiration
- Adventure travel
